subject: Google Charts demo does not run correctly & deployApp() function not found

messages.author: 2963b652d73501cb
messages.subject: Google Charts demo does not run correctly & deployApp() function not found
parts:
Hello,

I am having problems runnin the Google Charts demo that is posted in the gallery section.
I downloaded the files from github. If i run the App in RStudio the graph doesn't show. Only the slider does show.
The googleCharts is correctly installed as far as I can tell.

Here is what I get:
> shiny::runApp()

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:4333

Attache Paket: ‘googleCharts’

The following object is masked from ‘package:shiny’:

    column

Note: the specification for S3 class “AsIs” in package ‘jsonlite’ seems equivalent to one from package ‘RJSONIO’: not turning on duplicate class definitions for this class.

Attache Paket: ‘dplyr’

The following object is masked from ‘package:stats’:

    filter

The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’:

    intersect, setdiff, setequal, union

Warning in run(timeoutMs) :
  Paket ‘dplyr’ wurde unter R Version 3.1.3 erstellt

> deployApp()
Error: could not find function "deployApp"



Then I wanted to try to deploy it with deployApp(). But I get:
Error: could not find function "deployApp"

Yesterday I installed the new shiny version, is that a problem that comes with the new version? 
I am very confused why deploy function doesn't work. I need it urgently for a project.

I would appreciate your help very much!

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: Google Charts demo does not run correctly & deployApp() function not found
parts:
For your deploy issue: you need to specify shinyapps as part of the command:

shinyapps::deployApp()

or load the package first:

library(shinyapps)

Fereshteh
